```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(warn = 1)
```

## Load experiment object

```{r}
library(jaxExperiment)

expt_file = file.path("outputs", "experiment.rds")
expt = load_experiment(expt_file)
expt
```

## Filter counts and compute QC metrics

```{r}
spec3 = stage3_spec_default()
expt = stage3_prepare_de(expt, spec = spec3)
```

### Filtering summary

```{r}
knitr::kable(expt$counts_filtered$zero_filter$per_group, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Read depth vs expression quantile (q75)

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
stage3_plot_depth_vs_quantile(
  expt,
  color_by = "ko_strategy",
  shape_by = "model_system"
)
```

```{r, fig.width=5.2, fig.height=3}
stage3_plot_depth_vs_quantile(
  expt,
  color_by = "run_id",
  shape_by = "model_system"
)
```

## PCA of WT samples

```{r fig.width = 6, fig.height=4.5}
expt = stage3_compute_wt_pca(expt, spec = spec3)

stage3_plot_wt_pca(expt, color_by = "model_system")
stage3_plot_wt_pca(expt, color_by = "run_id")
```

## PCA within each model system + day + condition

```{r fig.width = 6, fig.height=4.5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
expt = stage3_compute_de_group_pca(expt)
stage3_plot_de_group_pca(expt)
```

## Optional: merge / correct run IDs (after PCA review)

```{r}
run_id_recode = c(
  "20250724_GT25-RobsonP-125-run2" = "20250702_GT25-RobsonP-125"
)

if (!is.null(run_id_recode)) {
  expt = stage3_recode_run_id(expt, recode = run_id_recode, strict = TRUE)
}
```

## Save experiment object (for later stages)

```{r}
save_experiment(expt, expt_file)
```

```{r}
gc()
sessionInfo()
```
